note: Recorded after the last development round and before the test exceptions were run for the first time.

changes_after_the_test.summary: No change alters a result. The files below were changed after the last model run that produced a reported number.

agent/llm.py.what: The endpoint class was rewritten: three reply formats, waiting on a rate limit, a clear stop on a refusal. The local-model class and the schema check are unchanged; one message in get_model was reworded.

agent/loop.py.what: One guard added: a model that returns nothing usable sends that exception to a person and no longer stops the run. One blank line added.

other_files_changed.06_evaluate.py: Reports how each hand-off came about and counts wrong proposals over every try; minutes are rounded. No score changed.
other_files_changed.08_summary.py: --no-model keeps the stored note when it still passes its checks. One sentence of the summary page, on how the escalation lines are set, was reworded in an audit on 2026-11-22; no number changed.
other_files_changed.tests/test_endpoint.py: Added: 20 checks of the endpoint code against a scripted stand-in service.
other_files_changed..github/workflows/regression.yml: Runs the endpoint checks and sets the model's system suffix.
other_files_changed.README.md: Written and corrected after the test.
other_files_changed.01_extract.py: Added --ranking, which asks CMS how many records each company has for the state. Its answer was added to data/extract/manifest.json. The extract itself is unchanged.
other_files_changed.04_reconcile.py, 06_evaluate.py, 07_reme: Each report page now opens with a line saying the errors are planted. No number changed; results/exception_log.csv has the same fingerprint as at the freeze.

recheck.what: Twelve test exceptions rerun with the final code, same model file and settings.
recheck.compared: status, cause, action, fix value, every step of the trace, every conclusion, tokens read and written
